Bill.BriefDescription: Providing schools information they need regarding who has legal custody, care, or control of students for purposes of providing notice.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing schools information they needregarding who has legal custody, care, or control of students forpurposes of providing notice; and adding a new section to chapter 26.09RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 26.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In any dissolution, legal separation, declaration concerningvalidity of marriage, nonparental custody, or petition for residentialschedule/parenting plan proceeding, the court clerk shall certify tothe superintendent of public instruction a copy of that portion of thedissolution, legal separation, declaration concerning validity ofmarriage, nonparental custody, or petition for residentialschedule/parenting plan decree, order, residential schedule, orparenting plan that describes the person or persons who have legalcustody, care, or control of any child subject to the decree, order,schedule, or plan. (2) The superintendent of public instruction shall provide theinformation as received from the court clerk to the superintendent of p. 1 HB 2786the school district in which any child subject to a decree, order,schedule, or plan is registered. The superintendent of the schooldistrict shall provide the information as received from thesuperintendent of public instruction to the principal of the school inwhich any child subject to a decree, order, schedule, or plan isregistered. (3) The school shall provide notice to the person or personsindicated in the decree, order, schedule, or plan, who have legalcustody, care, or control of any child who is registered with theschool, of matters for which notice is required to be given suchpersons or is otherwise generally provided to such persons, includingnotice of any meetings, events, trips, tests, grades, and disciplinaryactions.
